![dig in](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4a79223c62954be09bc499010091015cc3b156e_0.webp) **_Pixel Perfect x FARMER'S DELIGHT_**，呃，就是 **Farmer's Delight**，不過是專為 [**Pixel Perfect**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-legacy) 材質包設計的，由 [XSSheep](https://www.minecraftforum.net/members/XSSheep?__cf_chl_jschl_tk__=0cd05e71855cf2e8f211c9be122b2d9798fb86ca-1594543114-0-AXuCk8wmp99Q2MLjHOpHpVxrxoPjK70-Nt948w1ABLQPhkDmAKDyldwSZU9wCbrjgULVlrXWpSufWdiIIykCD__10vLmD_-tfkNffpsZBLqAsrp_6-wFOm3KLRyZ-ecDVmcUpWtbt_VZfqtoO_T0soWb-8WLLYQFbdKE72LiDstvcnvhmJzpcJNVMF9aYhLmAhLJ52epgEza9J9KZ64uY--ykq8Jr5NQZ2hu_Jj1He7KHoDsHQuPBoNNEI3fVeF8XCO3rxYpfoKvOGMznGDB0r6iNOgUFhTuLAOehjIYYTNH) 製作，並由 [NovaWostra](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra) 延續，我主要是依據他的作品來開發此材質包。 試試我的新材質包 **Pixel Perfection Fidelity**

這是一個 **相容性** 材質包，會更改 Farmer's Delight 的紋理，使其呈現獨特風格，以便與 [Pixel Perfection Legacy](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-legacy) 或 [Pixel Perfection Fidelity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-fidelity) 搭配使用。雖然建議與主材質包搭配使用，但也可作為獨立材質包使用，使 Farmer's Delight 的紋理看起來更具中世紀風、飽和度更低且更詳細。 您可以在這裡找到 [Farmer's Delight for fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) 和 [Farmer's Delight for forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)。 此資源封裝也支援 [Corn Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/corn-delight-fabric) 和 [Rustic Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/rustic-delight) (BETA)。 # 依賴項 - [Pixel Perfection Legacy](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-legacy) (必需) 或 [Pixel Perfection Fidelity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-fidelity) (必需) - [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) (必需) # **我的其他包** - [Pixel Perfection Fidelity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-fidelity) - [Pixel Perfection x THE TWILIGHT FOREST](https://modrinth.com/project/pixel-perfection-x-the-twilight-forest) - [Pixel Perfection x AD ASTRA](https://modrinth.com/project/pixel-perfection-x-ad-astra) - [Pixel Perfection x DEHYDRATION](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-x-dehydration) - [Pixel Perfection x CONTROLIFY](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-x-controlify) - [PPL Alternative GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-alternative-gui) - [PPL Compat Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-compatibility-pack) - [PPL Hodgepodge](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-hodgepodge) - [PPL Better Grass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-better-grass) - [PPL Custom Theme for Jade](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-custom-theme-for-jade)
